integrity: The result uses an analytical proof; finite numerical diagnostics are supplementary. Novel publication priority is not independently certified.
limitations: Exact finite-ball maximal logarithmic constants are proved on c0 only; on ell-p the theorem gives bounds and a sharp small-ball limit. The analysis concerns polynomial scalar weights and the ordinary unilateral shift.
title: Sharp logarithmic return packing for polynomially rescaled unilateral shifts
